sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Aries is ignition. The core impulse is to start—act fast, go first, learn by moving. At best: brave, direct, energizing. At worst: impatient, combative, bails when bored. Mastery is choosing worthy fights and pacing the sprint.

Aries themes are loud in the 1st house (identity, first moves), balanced by the 7th house (partners, contracts). Track your Mars sign and aspects—e.g., Sun conjunction Mars (pure drive), Mars trine Jupiter (courage + luck), Mars square Saturn (friction that needs a plan).

Opposite sign: Libra—the axis from “me” to “we.” Learn the building blocks in astrology charts or generate a free birth chart.

✅ Strengths

  • Initiative, courage, straight talk
  • Momentum builder; inspires action
  • Resilient—bounces after setbacks

⚠️ Friction Points

  • Impatience; interrupts or pushes
  • Starts many, finishes few
  • Heat turns to fights if needs go unnamed

🧭 Growth Moves

  • Set time-boxes; ship, then iterate
  • Ask before acting when people are involved
  • Cool-down rituals after conflict

sections.heading: How Aries Energy Behaves
sections.html:
Daily Life

  • Says yes to challenges and first tries
  • Prefers clear asks and fast decisions
  • Sports, startups, sprints—then a reset

Under Stress

  • Gets loud; fights instead of names needs
  • Quits when bored or blocked
  • Reset: one breath, one boundary, one next step

Somatic Tells

  • Jaw/neck tension from charging ahead
  • Heat in the face; quick pulse
  • Sweat + stretches clear the system

sections.heading: Love & Sex
sections.html:
Dating an Aries

  • Plan movement: competition, concerts, road trips
  • Be direct—clarity is hot
  • Give quick feedback; don’t let sparks smolder

Sex with Aries

  • Enthusiastic consent + playful challenge
  • Short runway to heat; variety keeps focus
  • Post-game cuddles calm the nervous system

Attachment Triggers

  • Mixed signals or slow replies
  • Score-keeping instead of straight talk
  • Public disrespect—keep conflict private, clean

sections.heading: Work & Money
sections.html:
Natural Lanes

  • Startups, sales, athletics, emergency roles
  • Negotiation, Ops that need fast calls
  • Any arena where initiative wins

Money Style

  • Impulsive buys—use 24h rules for big spends
  • Motivates with target goals and timers
  • Invests in tools that speed execution

Team Edge

  • Unblocks decisions; goes first in hard moments
  • Raises energy in low-morale rooms
  • Protects pace—keeps meetings honest

sections.heading: Growth Practices
sections.html:
Journal Prompts

  • Which goal deserves my next 30 focused days?
  • What am I angry about—and what’s the clean ask?
  • Where can I be brave without being brutal?

Bodywork

  • Sweaty intervals + long walks to discharge heat
  • Neck/jaw mobility and breath ladders
  • Cold-to-warm contrast to reset

Ritual

  • Daily “one bold thing” list (max 3 items)
  • Post-conflict repair within 24 hours
  • “Stop at 80%” rule—ship, then refine
